requirement.normalizedRequirement: PWOM shall include applicable emergency-provider contact procedures; IF ship_ice_strengthened = true, THEN PWOM shall also include prolonged-ice-entrapment life-support and integrity procedures.
requirement.requiredInputs: PWOM, emergency-contact procedure, ice-strengthening status, and entrapment procedure
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: The Manual shall include risk-based procedures to be followed for: contacting emergency response providers for salvage, search and rescue (SAR), spill response, etc., as applicable; and, in the case of ships ice strengthened in accordance with chapter 3, procedures for maintaining life support and ship integrity in the event of prolonged entrapment by ice.
